prompt: 16:9 horizontal cinematic frame, Oriental high-altitude divine realm, dominated by a cold moon-white color field, bright, silent, distant. The scene does not rely on many palaces but on the spatial relationship between high pavilions, ancient pines, a sea of clouds, and the sky. The only main spatial theme is: an open high pavilion on the edge of a cliff in an adversarial composition with an ancient pine tree stretching horizontally into the sky. The camera stands inside the pavilion at a normal eye level. Foreground left is a giant dark blue-gray pillar; above is a huge eave. Right side is the trunk of the giant pine. Middle ground is a wide moon-white stone terrace with minimalist decoration. One tiny fairy in a long red dress stands alone at the edge of the terrace, looking at the clouds with her back to the viewer. Colors include moon white, frost green, cool gray-blue, and cold stone white. Material: cold white jade, polished gray-blue stone, dark court wood structures. Soft cool daylight, huge negative space, architecture framing nature, nature interrupting architecture, restrained contrast, strong layered atmospheric depth.

promptZh: 16:9 横向电影画幅，东方高空神界，以清冷的月白色调为主，明亮、静谧、深远。场景不依赖过多的宫殿，而是通过高阁、古松、云海与天空之间的空间关系来构建。核心空间主题为：悬崖边缘的一座开放式高阁 与 一棵横向伸展入云的古松 形成的对抗性构图。摄像机位于阁楼内部，平视视角。左侧前景为一根巨大的深蓝灰色柱子，上方是巨大的屋檐。右侧为巨松树干。中景是一座宽阔的月白色石台，装饰极简。一位 身着红色长裙的纤细仙子 独自站在台边，背对观众凝视云海。色彩包括月白、霜绿、冷灰蓝与冷石白。材质：冷白玉、抛光灰蓝石、深色宫廷木结构。柔和的冷日光，巨大的留白，建筑框景自然，自然穿插建筑，克制的对比度，极具层次感的氛围深度。
